data.name: Beachboy Valet
data.headline: 3.5 Hours • Ages 5 yrs+ • “Ho'āli'i" (To Make Royal)
data.description: Enjoy a personalized experience with the Beachboy Valet, where a genuine Waikīkī Beachboy will guide you through a variety of water activities. Spend the morning surfing, paddling across the reef, or riding an outrigger canoe. This unique service is tailored to beginners and intermediate surfers alike.
data.highlights:
- Personal Beachboy Valet for customized water activities
- Suitable for beginner and intermediate surfers
- Enjoy surfing, paddling, and canoeing under expert guidance
data.itinerary:
- Choose from surfing, stand-up paddling, or an outrigger canoe ride
- Spend time learning and enjoying various water activities with a personal guide

meeting_point.address: Royal Hawaiian Hotel, 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI 96815

data.what_is_included:
- Personal Beachboy Valet for 3.5 hours
- All equipment, including surfboard, stand-up paddleboard, and outrigger canoe
- Use of a rash guard
data.what_is_not_included:
- Towel (unless a registered guest of The Royal Hawaiian)
- Storage for personal items or valuables
data.cancellation_summary: Submit cancellation requests 48 hours prior for a refund.
data.cancellation_notes:
If you wish to change or cancel your booking, please submit your request via e-mail to info@waikikibeachservices.com at least 48 hours before an activity/rental. No-shows or cancellation requests received within 48 hours will not be eligible for refund.

Please allow up to 10 business days for refunds to process between banking institutions.

#Check In

Please check in at least 10 minutes prior to your reservation time at our service desk located on the pool deck of The Royal Hawaiian Hotel at 2255 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI. 96815. Should you get lost or need assistance, please call our desk at (808) 388-1510.

#Things to Remember

Please bring your own towel. We do not provide towels unless you are a registered guest of The Royal Hawaiian Hotel. Leave valuables at home—there is limited storage available behind our desk. More information can be found in our [FAQs](http://www.waikikibeachservices.com/faqs/) section of our website.

data.restrictions: - Pregnant women or guests with prior neck or back injuries should not participate in surfing or stand-up paddling.
data.faqs:
- **Can I choose which activities to do?** 
Yes, guests can choose from surfing, stand-up paddling, or outrigger canoe rides.
- **Is this suitable for beginners?** 
Yes, this experience is designed for beginners as well as intermediate surfers.
